# Ansible Galaxy collections

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/ansible.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **ansible-core 2.21.5 on Python 3.14.0**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/ansible/${AW_REPO}/`

## Before connecting

- A valid Galaxy collection with namespace weave, name sample and version 1.0.0.

Authentication: Use an access or reference token as the HTTP Basic password, with AW_USER equal to its subject. The subject needs read permission for installation and deploy permission for publication on the selected repository; token scopes cannot exceed that identity. The same clients also accept a user password when Basic password authentication is enabled. Use HTTPS.

Fresh client state: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.

## Configure

0600 temporary configuration; use the trailing slash. Do not commit this expanded file.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
cat > "$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" <<EOF
[galaxy]
server_list=artifactweave
[galaxy_server.artifactweave]
url=$AW_URL/artifactory/api/ansible/$AW_REPO/
username=$AW_USER
password=$AW_TOKEN
EOF
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

collection/ contains galaxy.yml for weave.sample 1.0.0; publish required dependency collections first.

```sh
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CACHE_DIR="$AW_WORK/cache" ansible-galaxy collection build ./collection --output-path "$AW_WORK"
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CACHE_DIR="$AW_WORK/cache" ansible-galaxy collection publish "$AW_WORK/weave-sample-1.0.0.tar.gz" --import-timeout 30
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

Use a newly created AW_WORK for each independent install.

```sh
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" ANSIBLE_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/ansible.cfg" ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CACHE_DIR="$AW_WORK/cache" ansible-galaxy collection install weave.sample:==1.0.0 -p "$AW_WORK/installed"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Collection APIs are supported; this recipe does not claim legacy Galaxy role support.
- The pinned client requires Python 3.14 here; the Python 3.15 base failed its dataclasses integration.
